Madhya Pradesh to Build Roads Worth ₹80,000 Crore

Madhya Pradesh is set to construct 7 four-lane highways and expressways with an investment of ₹80,000 crore. This project is expected to benefit two crore people and reduce travel distances between cities including Bhopal and Satna. The initiative aims to expand the road network within the state.
